Estimating Daily Fluid Requirements 
for Healthy Individuals
*The 1 mL of fluid per calorie method should be used with caution because it will  
underestimate the fluid needs of those with low-calorie needs. Persons who are  
significantly obese may best be evaluated by Method 3 because it adjusts for high 
body weight.
